name: provider-failure-cause
title: A permanent provider failure must not read as transient: the record carries the provider's own code
description: Two measured permanent account states - 429 insufficient_quota and 402 insufficient_balance - are recorded as failureKind=transient, and the provider's own code is dropped from the record. Measured cost: seven attempts over five hours, and a session spent diagnosing a credential that was never broken.
creator: aixi
